provenance_note: Hand-derived from 131.0-B-6 9.2, 9.3.1 Figure 9-1, 10.3.4 and docs/standards/tm-sync.md SYNC-007 to SYNC-016 (OI-80, OI-81). Model test-vectors/models/sync.py, written blind (TV-023) by a Claude agent from the Blue Books and docs/ only, without reading any implementation; for format only it read the existing models (cop1.py, link_recv.py) and the vector schemas. The inputs were chosen by hand; the expected values are the model's, whose sequences it checks against the 40-bit notes of 131.0-B-6 10.4.3 (note 2) and whose search engine it checks against a second, offline formulation. Where the documents are silent the model refuses the case (README of test-vectors/sync/). The file is written by the model (--write) and never edited by hand.

scenarios.description: A chunk that completes two 3-octet units needs 6 octets of output: an area of 5 fails with BufferTooSmall, needed 6, and changes nothing (the state stays Searching, no unit counted); the same chunk with an area of 6 returns both units.

Only the units that the chunk completes count: a chunk that completes one 4-octet unit and starts a second needs 4 octets; an area of 3 fails with needed 4, an area of 4 succeeds and the second unit is still partial (Collecting).
A chunk that completes no unit needs no output area: an area of 0 is enough.

After a BufferTooSmall error the state is exactly as before: the half-read marker of the first chunk is still there, so the second chunk, refused once for want of output, then accepted, gives the same unit as an uninterrupted run.
